name: Zenlayer RGN4 Yangon Data Center, Nattalin
notes: Directory listings place Zenlayer's RGN4 Yangon Data Center at Yangon Bakery, Unnamed Road, Nattalin, Bago Region. No official Zenlayer facility page, capacity, certification, or operating-status evidence was found; location appears to be a directory-only/edge colocation listing.

name: Ocean Wave IDC, Mandalay
notes: Data Center Map lists Ocean Wave IDC at 37a Shwe Bo Street, Mandalay, operated by Ocean Wave Communication Co., Ltd.; described as a state-of-the-art data center providing internet/DIA/fiber services. Capacity not disclosed and no primary operator data-center page was found.

name: MPT Yangon Data Centers - Hantharwady and Bayintnaung
notes: MPT's official business page states that MPT provides data-center service in Yangon at Hantharwady and that the new Bayintnaung Data Center is ready to provide service; capacity not disclosed.

name: True IDC Myanmar, MICT Park
developer: True Internet Data Center / True IDC
notes: True IDC's official Myanmar page states that it established True IDC Myanmar in 2015, the first commercial data center in Myanmar, located at MICT Park, Yangon. Directory sources also list the facility, but capacity is not disclosed on the official page.

name: Yatanarpon Teleport DC Yangon
notes: Yatanarpon Teleport's official enterprise data-center page says it houses a data center in Yangon serving more than 120 corporate clients. DC Hub reports a 3.0 MW operational facility in Hlaing, but the official page does not disclose capacity, so capacity_mw is left null.

name: Golden TMH Telecom / GMBX Yangon Data Center
developer: Golden TMH Telecom Co., Ltd. (GTMH); Golden Myanmar Business Exchange
notes: GTMH's official page describes GTMH DC as a pioneer data center in Myanmar supporting enterprise sectors. DCD reported in 2017 that GMBX already operated a Yangon data center and planned a second $5m facility possibly in Mandalay or Nay Pyi Taw; DC Hub reports 3.0 MW for Golden Myanmar Business Exchange, but capacity is not confirmed on the official page.

name: Myint & Associates Data Center, Vantage Tower
notes: Myint & Associates' official site markets M&A Data Center in Yangon; Uptime Institute lists Myint & Associates Data Center in Yangon in its awards database. Data Center Map locates the facility at Vantage Tower, 623 Pyay Road, Kamayut Township. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Burst Myanmar Thilawa SEZ Tier IV Data Center
developer: Burst Myanmar Co. Ltd.; Burst Networks; Flexenclosure; 1-Net Singapore support
notes: DCD reported Dagon International's investment in Burst's upcoming Tier IV data center in Thilawa SEZ, Yangon Region. Baxtel says Burst holds a 50-year lease on 5,007 sqm in Zone A where it is constructing a Tier IV datacenter and telecom compound; Uptime lists Thilawa SEZ Datacenter. Current operating status and IT load were not found, so status follows the latest facility-directory construction wording.

name: Campana CLS Containerized Data Center, Thanlyin
developer: Campana MYTHIC Co. Ltd.; Campana Group; Delta Electronics
notes: Delta announced it supplied a 200 kW modular/containerized data-center solution for Campana's Myanmar submarine cable landing station, designed for the SIGMAR/MYTHIC connectivity project. DC Hub and PeeringDB identify Campana CLS in Thanlyin, Yangon. Capacity_mw reflects Delta's 200 kW statement.
